nodes.name: Schedule
nodes.notes: 47 7 * * 1-5 Europe/Paris — the exact slot plan-auto-post-linkedin.md specifies.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Every environment-specific value. apiVersion and userAgent mirror publish.py.

nodes.name: List repo tree
nodes.notes: One call for every path, so we can tell which drafts have a PNG sibling.

nodes.name: Fetch draft
nodes.notes: Runs once per draft. Uses the API, not raw.githubusercontent, so a just-written marker is never served from CDN cache — and it returns the blob sha needed to write back.

nodes.name: Select draft
nodes.notes: Returns NO items when a post already went out today, or when the queue is empty. That stops the workflow — a clean, empty execution.

nodes.name: Init image upload
nodes.notes: This is the call LinkedIn's WAF 400s from datacenter IPs. It works here only because the n8n namespace egresses via the home ISP — do not route it through Tailscale.

nodes.name: Build payload
nodes.notes: Text-only if the draft has no PNG or the upload failed — publish.py degrades the same way rather than aborting.

nodes.name: Post to LinkedIn
nodes.notes: RETRY MUST STAY OFF: a retry after a partial success posts twice. fullResponse because the created URN comes back in the x-restli-id HEADER, not the body.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ message: 'chore(linkedin): mark draft as published [skip ci]', content: $json.contentBase64, sha: $json.sha, branch: $('Config').first().json.branch, committer: { name: 'linkedin-drip[bot]', email: 'linkedin-drip@users.noreply.github.com' } }) }}

nodes.name: Commit marker
nodes.notes: Same commit subject the CronJob used, so the [skip ci] convention and the 'gap of more than a day' check in the plan still hold.

nodes.name: Result
nodes.notes: imageSkipped non-empty means the post went out text-only — check egress.
